description: This file is a shell script (.sh) used for testing the cherry-pick functionality in Git. It contains test cases, setup procedures, and commands to verify behavior of cherry-picking commits under various scenarios.

methods.name: check_head_differs_from
methods.description: Checks that the current HEAD differs from a specified commit or reference.

methods.name: check_head_equals
methods.description: Checks that the current HEAD is equal to a specified commit or reference.
